judgments.sourceReason: s0629 將受詔，未及而卒，時年二十七 is Chonghua’s actual death and a stated age of27; s0630 在位十一年 supplies an eleven-year tenure. The earlier s0498 父卒，時年十六 immediately precedes s0499 永和二年 accession. These linked age/tenure constraints cannot be ignored merely because a post346 bound is mechanically valid. They do not explicitly give a death era-year. Reckoning conventions, the tenure start, and reconciliation require deliberate source research; do not assume inclusive or elapsed counting, derive a birth/death year, or erase this genuine unresolved chronology by retaining only the broad lower floor.
